newsitem.title: USA: New book promises to reveal more about spy Ames.
newsitem.headline: New book promises to reveal more about spy Ames.

text.p: Aldrich Ames, a CIA agent who spied for Russia, has cooperated in the publication of a book that its publishers said on Thursday will answer unresolved questions about his case, including whether the CIA has more double agents in its ranks.
The Putnam Publishing Group said Ames gave 50 hours of interviews to former Washington Post reporter Pete Earley that were conducted "without the agency's knowledge or approval."
Earley's book, "Confessions of a Spy," will be published Feb. 10 after serialization in U.S. News & World Report.
Ames is serving a life sentence for treason.
Putnam said Earley's book will deal with such questions as whether the true extent damage Ames did to the U.S. spy network has been revealed.
Besides serialization, the publisher said ABC's Nightline programme will devote several nights to discussing the book, starting Feb. 10.
